assumptions.statement: The overall design boundary and three key-area polygons are provisional rough constraints from the public repository, not trusted official planning boundaries.
assumptions.impact: Current area and ratio metrics are low-confidence interim design-model values. Official geometry triggers full recalculation of all dependent geometry, metrics, figures, reports, drawings and HTML.

assumptions.statement: FAR, building height, building coverage, setbacks, road redlines, ownership, existing-building conditions, heritage controls, utilities, fire safety and engineering constraints remain unavailable or incomplete.
assumptions.impact: Land use, massing, retain-renovate-demolish, mobility and infrastructure content remains conceptual and cannot be used as a statutory, approval or engineering conclusion.

assumptions.statement: Operating entities, site permissions, staff, insurance, costs, data agreements, dual-account governance and annual event resources have not been formally appointed or contracted.
assumptions.impact: Scenario schedules, industry tests, public-return mechanisms and phasing are operating recommendations whose launch depends on named owners, budgets and stop/restoration protocols.

assumptions.statement: The quantities, concept unit rates, CAPEX, OPEX, revenue, NOI and payback values in visual/assets/economics_model.json and the bilingual FIG-10 diagrams are participant-authored internal scenario inputs effective 2026-08-29.
assumptions.impact: They support comparison between light-start, standard and full-rollout concepts only. They are low-confidence until measured quantities, dated market quotations, tax and financing treatment, operator agreements and approved design information replace the current assumptions.

assumptions.statement: As of 2026-08-30, all declared bilingual narratives, figures, A3/A0 PDFs, HTML deliverables, manifest hashes and self-check outputs have been refreshed for this package version.
assumptions.impact: ready_for_review means file-complete and self-checked; it does not raise provisional geometry or concept economics to official, statutory, engineering, procurement or investment evidence.
